name: network-canvas
description: Network's Canvas 2D tier for roughly 2,000 to 20,000 elements (plan §3.2): pass it as renderer={NetworkCanvas} and Network admits it above its canvasThreshold. One device-pixel canvas paints the SVG tier's marks — edges through Path2D from the same path data — in inks read through the cascade, so a brand scope and dark mode both apply. It only paints: the keyboard, the announcer, hit-testing and the table stay with Network, which shows the table instead before hydration and in forced colours. No glyphs; labels from half scale up.
